stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Colder weather settles in for Thanksgiving week. Another rain storm arrives Thursday night and into Friday.

stories.title: Seth Meyers to feature NEWS CENTER Maine mug on his show
stories.summary: Catch a glimpse of NEWS CENTER Maine pride on "Late Night with Seth Meyers."

stories.title: Teenager dies after canoe overturns in Moosehead Lake
stories.summary: A 17-year-old has died after his canoe overturned in Moosehead Lake while paddling with friends on Saturday. His body was recovered on Sunday.

stories.title: Portland councilor wants state law changed to give cities more control over speed limits
stories.summary: A Portland city councilor is pushing for a change in state law that would allow cities to set their own speed limits, as concerns grow about pedestrian safety.

stories.title: Teaching tops Maine job searches for second straight year as educators find a home in the state
stories.summary: From Hawaii to New York, educators are coming to Maine from across the country... and staying.

stories.title: Officials say first deer hunt in a century on MDI is going smoothly as critics seek moratorium
stories.summary: More than 30 deer have been harvested in Tremont this month. Now, opponents are looking to pause hunting across Mount Desert Island.

stories.title: School bus crash in Industry kills woman, leaves all aboard uninjured
stories.summary: A school bus crashed in Industry, according to the Franklin County Sheriff's Office.

stories.title: Brunswick airport customs facility plan raises concerns
stories.summary: A proposed U.S. Customs and Border Protection facility at the Brunswick airport is drawing concerns, but airport officials say it's to help businesses.

stories.title: For three decades, they’ve been the voice of UMaine Football
stories.summary: Rich Kimball & Bob Lucy have spent 30 years together, calling UMaine football on the radio.

stories.title: Feeling thirsty? Here are some tips to avoid dehydration and drink more water
stories.summary: Dr. Allyson Coffin, local chiropractor and wellness expert, stopped by the 207 studio to talk about signs of dehydration and tips to drink more water this summer.

stories.title: Chef Devin Finigan shares an easy to make seafood pasta dish full of fresh Maine flavors
stories.summary: This seafood pasta recipe uses fresh Maine seafood you can tailor to your taste.

stories.title: 40-year-old from Ashland dies in crash early Monday morning
stories.summary: Andreanna Munson died in the single-vehicle crash, officials said. Another occupant was taken to the hospital with serious injuries.
